acceptanceCriteria: Owner decision recorded: STR-V0-011 amendment text accepted, or V1-1609 declined/archived with reason.
body: V1-1609 asks for per-unit fingerprints and `runs reusable` classification of `corvint test` units from receipts. STR-V0-011 (decision 0524) forbids receipts feeding selection or ranking, enforced by TestSTRV0011ReceiptsHaveNoOtherReader. The run/preflight lane (#1062) left V1-1609 undelivered. Question for the owner: amend STR-V0-011 to allow a reuse-only reader, or decline V1-1609.
title: V1-1609 needs an owner amendment of STR-V0-011 before receipts can feed `runs reusable` unit classification
